GeneDef.label: phoenix fire
GeneDef.description: Archites distributed in the blood burn chemfuel into bright phoenix flames inside the carrier. Phoenix flames replenish faster the longer chemfuel has been burning uninterrupted and the more chemfuel is being burned and deplete faster the more flames are in the carrier. The carrier can utilize these flames to power abilities, items, and buildings which require phoenix flames.

customEffectDescriptions.li: Allows a pawn to utilize genes, items, or buildings that require phoenix flames.

GeneDef.label: chemfuel drain
GeneDef.description: Carriers burn an additional 15 chemfuel per day due to the extra heat in their bodies.
